_meta.purpose: Round-12 room-condition control for the Oct-2022 campaign: 6577/6976 Oct free-run certification (tau repeatability), campaign masking-release table, and the mask-clamp method test. Presentation data for dashboard section 10.
_meta.source: scn_photometry/r12_roomlight_control_final.py -> analysis_out/r12_roomlight_control.json; builder scn_photometry/build_room_control_json.py; every campaign read cross-checked against the shipped trackb_qc_screen.json ld_dd_note (PR #47, merge 5e782486)
_meta.q_semantics: 'q' is the chi2 periodogram peak-to-24h-peak q-ratio (house confidence floor 2.0), not a CI

campaign.note: no LD-week baseline on this chain (fiber-6 swap at the 221022→221024 boundary)
fiber-6 pre-split; LD week only, no DD wheel coverage

tau_scatter.ruling: Per Jules's ruling (2026-09-15): ~24 h endogenous tau is within the ordinary scatter of mouse free-run periods (this corpus: 23.3-24.1), so no external cue is required to explain the ~24 h reads.

verdict.through_oct17: DARK/zeitgeber-free CERTIFIED: 6577/6976 free-ran (tau 23.6/23.3 unmasked chi2, matching Aug 23.6/23.8) through their logged-DD Sep 28-Oct 17 chain in the same rig
verdict.campaign_dd_span_oct22_nov4: Supports DD: masking released in 8/8 campaign animals (daytime activity emerges vs their own zero-daytime LD week; deltas -0.046 to -0.566). Sustained LD is contradicted; 6577/6976 free-run 5 days pre-switch shows the room was DD-capable and standing-DD.
verdict.caveat: No instrument evidence (photodiodes off from Sep 28); verdict is behavioral (masking + free-run), not measured lux.

method.mask_clamp: Masking wheel events to the ZT18–6 night window before period estimation clamps left-marching free-run onsets at the 18:00 window edge and injects a structural 24 h component: certified free-runners 6577/6976 read tau 24.0 (q 1.0), drift 0.0/0.026 h/day under the masked method vs unmasked 23.6/23.3. The r11 drift-based '24 h-locked' claim was withdrawn 2026-09-15 (CORRECTION in trackb_qc_screen.json ld_dd_note).
method.photodiode: Through Sep 27 the room photodiode tracked the LD cycle; from Sep 28 logging was disabled in the rig config (plotparams.doRoomPhotodiode=0) and every file is a session-open point sample — the campaign's own logged-LD camera-test sessions carry the same single-point files, so Oct-era photodiode silence carries no light-state information either way.
